name: Biology
description: Study of living organisms, their structure, function, growth, and evolution. Includes practical laboratory work and field studies.

name: Chemistry
description: Exploration of matter, its properties, composition, and reactions. Emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and practical experimentation.

name: Physics
description: Understanding the fundamental laws of nature, including mechanics, electricity, magnetism, and thermodynamics.

name: Mathematics
description: Development of logical reasoning and problem-solving skills through algebra, geometry, calculus, and statistics.

name: English Language
description: Comprehensive study of English grammar, literature, composition, and oral communication skills.

name: Literature in English
description: Critical analysis of prose, poetry, and drama from various literary traditions and time periods.

name: History
description: Study of Uganda's history, East African history, and world events. Analyzes political, social, and economic developments.

name: Geography
description: Exploration of physical and human geography, including landforms, climate, population, and resource management.

name: Christian Religious Education
description: Study of Christian beliefs, values, and ethics. Includes biblical studies and application of Christian principles to daily life.

name: Art and Design
description: Development of creative skills through drawing, painting, sculpture, and design. Encourages artistic expression and visual literacy.

name: Music
description: Exploration of music theory, performance, and composition. Includes both Western and Ugandan musical traditions.

name: Commerce
description: Introduction to business principles, trade, marketing, and entrepreneurship. Prepares students for careers in commerce.

name: Economics
description: Advanced study of economic principles, markets, production, and national income. Analyzes both micro and macroeconomic concepts.

name: Computer Studies / ICT
description: Development of digital literacy, programming concepts, and practical ICT skills. Covers hardware, software, and internet technologies.

name: Entrepreneurship
description: Study of business creation, management, and innovation. Focuses on practical skills for starting and running a business.

name: Luganda Language
description: Study of the Luganda language, including grammar, composition, oral skills, and appreciation of Buganda culture.

name: Agriculture
description: Introduction to farming practices, crop production, animal husbandry, and sustainable agricultural techniques.

name: Physical Education
description: Development of physical fitness, sports skills, and teamwork through athletics, games, and outdoor activities.
